verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ לֹֽא־ יִטַּמָּ֖א בְּעַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem lə·ne·p̄eš lō- yiṭ·ṭam·mā bə·‘am·māw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Speak to Aaron’s sons the priests and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם־ לִשְׁאֵר֔וֹ הַקָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑יו לְאִמּ֣וֹ וּלְאָבִ֔יו וְלִבְנ֥וֹ וּלְבִתּ֖וֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- liš·’ê·rōw haq·qā·rōḇ ’ê·lāw lə·’im·mōw ū·lə·’ā·ḇîw wə·liḇ·nōw ū·lə·ḇit·tōw ū·lə·’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: except . . . for his immediate . . . family his mother father son daughter or brother

verses.original: וְלַאֲחֹת֤וֹ הַבְּתוּלָה֙ הַקְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הָיְתָ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ לָ֖הּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·la·’ă·ḥō·ṯōw hab·bə·ṯū·lāh haq·qə·rō·w·ḇāh ’ê·lāw ’ă·šer lō- hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’îš lāh yiṭ·ṭam·mā
verses.literal: or his unmarried sister who is near to him since she has no husband

verses.original: לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּ֖א בַּ֣עַל בְּעַמָּ֑יו לְהֵ֖חַלּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yiṭ·ṭam·mā ba·‘al bə·‘am·māw lə·hê·ḥal·lōw
verses.literal: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage . . . and so profane himself

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִקְרְחָה קָרְחָה֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם וּפְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ וּבִ֨בְשָׂרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yiq·rə·ḥå̄h qā·rə·ḥāh bə·rō·šām ū·p̄ə·’aṯ zə·qā·nām lō yə·ḡal·lê·ḥū ū·ḇiḇ·śā·rām lō yiś·rə·ṭū śā·rā·ṭeṯ
verses.literal: Priests must not make bald . . . spots on their heads shave off the edges of their beards . . . . . . or make cuts in their bodies . . .

verses.original: קְדֹשִׁ֤ים יִהְיוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת־ אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḏō·šîm yih·yū lê·lō·hê·hem wə·lō yə·ḥal·lə·lū šêm ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem kî ’eṯ- ’iš·šê Yah·weh le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem hêm maq·rî·ḇim wə·hā·yū qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God Because they present to the LORD the food offerings the food of their God they must be holy

verses.original: אִשָּׁ֨ה זֹנָ֤ה וַחֲלָלָה֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵאִישָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ כִּֽי־ קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’iš·šāh zō·nāh wa·ḥă·lā·lāh lō yiq·qā·ḥū wə·’iš·šāh gə·rū·šāh mê·’î·šāh lō yiq·qā·ḥū kî- qā·ḏōš hū lê·lō·hāw
verses.literal: A priest must not marry . . . a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband for the priest is holy to his God

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־ אֶת־ לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב קָדֹשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qid·daš·tōw kî- ’eṯ- le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā hū maq·rîḇ qā·ḏōš yih·yeh- lāḵ kî qā·ḏō·wōš ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·diš·ḵem
verses.literal: You are to regard him as holy since he presents the food of your God He shall be holy to you because I the LORD am holy I who set you apart

verses.original: וּבַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תֵחֵ֖ל לִזְנ֑וֹת אֶת־ אָבִ֙יהָ֙ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaṯ ’îš kō·hên kî ṯê·ḥêl liz·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·hā hî mə·ḥal·le·leṯ bā·’êš tiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: If a priest’s daughter . . . defiles herself by prostituting herself she profanes her father she must be burned in the fire

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יוּצַ֥ק עַל־ רֹאשׁ֣וֹ׀ שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ לִלְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־ הַבְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת־ רֹאשׁוֹ֙ לֹ֣א יִפְרָ֔ע וּבְגָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א יִפְרֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl mê·’e·ḥāw ’ăšer- yū·ṣaq ‘al- rō·šōw še·men ham·miš·ḥāh ū·mil·lê ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw lil·bōš ’eṯ- hab·bə·ḡā·ḏîm ’eṯ- rō·šōw lō yip̄·rā‘ ū·ḇə·ḡā·ḏāw lō yip̄·rōm
verses.literal: The priest who is highest among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained - to wear the priestly garments must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments . . .

verses.original: וְעַ֛ל כָּל־ נַפְשֹׁ֥ת מֵ֖ת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א לְאָבִ֥יו וּלְאִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al kāl- nap̄·šōṯ mêṯ lō yā·ḇō lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·lə·’im·mōw lō yiṭ·ṭam·mā
verses.literal: He must not go near any dead body he must not defile himself even for his father or mother

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְלֹ֣א יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑יו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- ham·miq·dāš lō yê·ṣê wə·lō yə·ḥal·lêl ’êṯ miq·daš ’ĕ·lō·hāw kî nê·zer še·men miš·ḥaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘ā·lāw ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: He must not leave . . . or desecrate the sanctuary of his God for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him I am the LORD

verses.original: וְה֕וּא אִשָּׁ֥ה בִבְתוּלֶ֖יהָ יִקָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ’iš·šāh ḇiḇ·ṯū·le·hā yiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: The woman he marries must be a virgin

verses.original: אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּגְרוּשָׁה֙ וַחֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת־ אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם־ בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵעַמָּ֖יו יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·mā·nāh ū·ḡə·rū·šāh wa·ḥă·lā·lāh zō·nāh ’eṯ- ’êl·leh lō yiq·qāḥ kî ’im- bə·ṯū·lāh mê·‘am·māw yiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: He is not to marry . . . . . . a widow a divorced woman or one defiled by prostitution - He is to marry . . . a virgin from his own people

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖וֹ בְּעַמָּ֑יו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yə·ḥal·lêl zar·‘ōw bə·‘am·māw kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šōw
verses.literal: so that he does not defile his offspring among his people for I am the LORD who sanctifies him

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֞ לְדֹרֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרַ֔ב לְהַקְרִ֖יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr ’îš miz·zar·‘ă·ḵā lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām ’ă·šer yih·yeh ḇōw mūm lō yiq·raḇ lə·haq·rîḇ le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: Say to Aaron For the generations to come none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָל־ אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֑ב אִ֤ישׁ עִוֵּר֙ א֣וֹ פִסֵּ֔חַ א֥וֹ חָרֻ֖ם א֥וֹ שָׂרֽוּעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl ’îš ’ă·šer- bōw mūm lō yiq·rāḇ ’îš ‘iw·wêr ’ōw p̄is·sê·aḥ ’ōw ḥā·rum ’ōw śā·rū·a‘
verses.literal: No . . . man who has any defect may approach no man who is blind lame . . . disfigured . . . or deformed

verses.original: א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בֶר רָ֑גֶל א֖וֹ שֶׁ֥בֶר יָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ’îš ’ă·šer- yih·yeh ḇōw še·ḇer rā·ḡel ’ōw še·ḇer yāḏ
verses.literal: no man who has a broken foot or . . . hand

verses.original: אֽוֹ־ גִבֵּ֣ן אוֹ־ דַ֔ק א֖וֹ תְּבַלֻּ֣ל בְּעֵינ֑וֹ א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת א֖וֹ מְר֥וֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- ḡib·bên ’ōw- ḏaq ’ōw tə·ḇal·lul bə·‘ê·nōw ’ōw ḡā·rāḇ ’ōw yal·le·p̄eṯ ’ōw mə·rō·w·aḥ ’ā·šeḵ
verses.literal: or who is a hunchback or dwarf or who has an eye defect a festering rash . . . scabs . . . or a crushed testicle

verses.original: כָּל־ אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֣וֹ מ֗וּם מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֣א יִגַּ֔שׁ לְהַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ אֵ֚ת לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ לְהַקְרִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš ’ă·šer- bōw mūm miz·ze·ra‘ ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên lō yig·gaš lə·haq·rîḇ ’eṯ- ’iš·šê Yah·weh mūm bōw ’êṯ le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hāw lō yig·gaš lə·haq·rîḇ
verses.literal: No . . . descendant of Aaron the priest . . . who has a defect shall approach to present the food offerings to the LORD Since he has a defect he is not to come near to offer the food of his God

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו מִקָּדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּמִן־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hāw miq·qā·ḏə·šê haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ū·min- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm yō·ḵêl
verses.literal: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־ הַפָּרֹ֜כֶת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ כִּֽי־ מ֣וּם בּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יְחַלֵּל֙ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשַׁ֔י כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’el- hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ lō yā·ḇō wə·’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lō yig·gaš kî- mūm bōw wə·lō yə·ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- miq·dā·šay kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šām
verses.literal: but because he has a defect he must not go . . . near the veil or approach the altar so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries For I am the LORD who sanctifies them

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw wə·’el- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Moses told this to Aaron and his sons . . . and to all the Israelites . . .
